question: When light passes through a prism, which colour is deviated the least
solution:
The correct answer is __**Red**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dispersion of light: The splitting of white light, when it passes through glass prism into its constituent spectrum is known as the dispersion of light.
 
• This is the reason why white light from the sun splits into 7 colours – Violet, Indigo, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, and Red (VIBGYOR).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11866c472f9664763858d0d83a5f29d9464048fc1bb51520cd4d621e99ad1a20.png] 

 
• And from this, we can see that red deviates least from its mean path and violet is deviated most.

Explanation:__

From the above explanation we can see that, when a beam of white light passes through a glass prism, the colour of the light beam that deviates the least is Red.
